Battery for better life.

Welcome to the European Head Office of Korea's No. 1 battery manufacturer, located in Frankfurt am Main, Germany. We are trusted OE partners of BMW, Volkswagen, Hyundai & KIA. For the Independent Aftermarket, we are your reliable partner for high-quality batteries.

Join Sebang Europe!

Looking for a new challenge with a global leader in battery manufacturing? Join our European team in Frankfurt am Main, Germany! With over 1,200 employees in 130 countries, we produce cutting-edge, maintenance-free batteries for top brands like BMW, VW, and Hyundai. Be part of our continued growth and help power the future.

We’re currently hiring for roles like Sales Manager and Sales Employee! If these roles don’t fit your profile, feel free to explore our other job opportunities. We’re always on the lookout for talented individuals to help us grow. Apply today and become part of our success!

Some of our OE Partners

Welcome to the European Head Office of Korea's No. 1 battery manufacturer, located in Frankfurt am Main, Germany. We are trusted OE partners of BMW, Volkswagen, Hyundai & KIA. For the Independent Aftermarket, we are your reliable partner for high-quality batteries.
